description: Representation-neutral geometric entry gate for the common target-embodiment LEFT grasp realization. It intentionally does not use wrist distance.
selection_provenance: Frozen before ACT EVAL10 rerun after reference-level preflight showed the prior 65/40/55 closure-neighborhood gate activated only after open-hand contact had already displaced the free object. The 90/80/65 bounds define the pre-contact Dex3 graspable-palm approach volume, enclose all frozen Proposed-B reference approaches, and remain below the Fair-A reference whole-hand minimum distance of 114 mm. No ACT outcome or task-success threshold was used.
